pageTitle: Blind Spot Interval: spaced review reminders for students
demoSoon: This topic needs another review soon.
demoPractice: A little more practice will help this topic stick.
demoLater: You can wait longer before reviewing this topic again.
faqTopicAnswer: Something you studied and want to remember, such as the chain rule.
faqReviewAnswer: Explain the topic from memory. Check your notes, then rate what you remembered.
faqDatesAnswer: Your ratings help set the next review date. We look for a time inside your study hours.
faqCalendarAnswer: No. You can see all your reviews in the app.
faqLoginAnswer: Your Google account lets you return to your saved topics and reviews.
rightTime: Reviewing at the right time is how you beat it.
intro: Add a topic you just learned. Blind Spot Interval picks the best days to review it, so it sticks.
stepAddCopy: Type a name, like Chain rule. That is all it needs.
stepReviewCopy: We schedule it inside your study hours. Reviews appear on Today and, if you want, in Google Calendar.
stepRateCopy: Try to explain it from memory, then rate how it went. Easy topics come back later. Hard ones come back sooner.
benefitTime: Short sessions. The default review is 15 minutes.
benefitHours: Fits your day. Reviews land inside the study hours you set.
firstHelp: We will schedule your first review automatically.
upcomingEmpty: Your upcoming reviews will appear here.
emptyTopicsCopy: Add a topic you studied to schedule a review.
